content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked extensive information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include a new-generation HomePod mini, a security camera, a new Siri Remote designed to work with the upcoming Apple TV 4K, and the long-awaited HomePad product.

After digging deeper into the code, it also appears to provide important clues about the design direction of the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito from Engadget discovered that, although the HomePad is likely to run some version of tvOS, it may operate more like a larger version of the Apple Watch.

The code also reveals a rather thoughtful privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on the widget when it detects that your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions — one featuring a speaker base similar to the HomePod, and another designed for wall-mounted installation.

In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned above, several other unknown devices have also been referenced. Personally, I'm really hoping one of them turns out to be a smart doorbell. Are there any Apple home products you're particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
